info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/ltx-2.3-quality/extend-video
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/ltx-2.3-quality/extend-video queue.

x-fal-metadata.about: Extend a video forward or backward from a text prompt.

video_quality.description: The quality preset of the generated video.
video_quality.title: Video Quality

video_url.description: The URL of the video to extend.
video_url.title: Video URL

enable_safety_checker.description: Whether to enable the safety checker.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

frames_per_second.description: Frames per second of the generated video.
frames_per_second.title: FPS

guidance_scale.description: Classifier-free guidance scale. The default is tuned for fast, high-quality generation.
guidance_scale.title: Guidance Scale

extend_direction.description: Direction to extend the video. 'forward' continues from the end of the video, 'backward' generates a new beginning.
extend_direction.title: Extend Direction

num_frames.description: The number of frames to generate for the extension segment, including num_context_frames of overlap with the source video. The new content adds approximately (num_frames - num_context_frames) / frames_per_second seconds. The stable generation budget caps the resolution x frames volume: at 24 fps roughly 20s at 480p-class, 11s at 720p-class and 5s at 1080p-class; a request above the budget returns a 422 (lower num_frames or use a smaller resolution).
num_frames.title: Number of Frames

num_context_frames.description: The number of source frames used as context/overlap for the extension. Snapped down to the LTX temporal grid (8k+1) and clamped to the frames available in the source video.
num_context_frames.title: Number of Context Frames

examples: Continue the scene naturally, maintaining the same style and motion.
prompt.description: The prompt describing how the video should continue.
prompt.title: Prompt

generate_audio.description: Whether to generate new audio for the extension segment (crossfaded with the source audio at the seam). When disabled, the source video's own audio track is preserved and the extension stays silent.
generate_audio.title: Generate Audio

video_write_mode.description: The write mode of the generated video.
video_write_mode.title: Video Write Mode

seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility. If None, a random seed is chosen.
seed.title: Seed

resolution.description: The size of the generated video. 'auto' follows the source video size/aspect up to the LTX limits; the source is scaled to the final size in the stitched output. Sizes are 32px-aligned (e.g. 1920x1080 is delivered as 1888x1056). Higher resolutions reduce the maximum stable extension length; lower resolutions can run longer.
resolution.title: Resolution

num_inference_steps.description: Number of inference steps. Defaults to 15 and can be increased up to 30.
num_inference_steps.title: Number of Inference Steps

end_image_strength.description: Conditioning strength of the optional end keyframe. 1.0 = exact match, lower = more freedom for the model.
end_image_strength.title: End Image Strength

match_input_fps.description: When enabled, the output FPS matches the source video's FPS (rounded to an integer and clamped to the supported range) instead of frames_per_second.
match_input_fps.title: Match Input FPS

video_strength.description: Conditioning strength of the source context frames. 1.0 keeps the overlap locked to the source for a seamless transition; lower values give the model more freedom.
video_strength.title: Video Strength

end_image_url.description: Optional keyframe image for the far end of the extension: the final frame for forward extension, or the new first frame for backward extension.
end_image_url.title: End Image URL

negative_prompt.default: color distortion, overexposure, static, blurry details, subtitles, style, artwork, painting, frame, still, dim overall tone, worst quality, low quality, JPEG compression artifacts, ugly, mutilated, extra fingers, poorly drawn hands, poorly drawn face, deformed, disfigured, malformed limbs, fused fingers, motionless frame, cluttered background, three legs, crowded background, walking backwards
negative_prompt.description: The negative prompt to steer generation away from.
negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt

sync_mode.description: If True, the media is returned as a data URI inline in the response. Useful for short-lived requests and tests.
sync_mode.title: Sync Mode

Ltx23QualityExtendVideoInput.description:
Extend a video forward (continue the ending) or backward (prepend a
beginning).

The last (forward) or first (backward) ``num_context_frames`` of the
source video condition the head/tail of a fresh LTX-2.3 generation via the
official Lightricks guide mechanism, and the generated segment is
crossfaded onto the source over that overlap. Field surface follows the
hosted ``ltx-2.3-22b/extend-video`` endpoint. Audio for the extension is
newly generated from the prompt (the ComfyUI graph has no audio-context
conditioning); it is crossfaded with the source audio at the seam rather
than continuing the source soundtrack.
Ltx23QualityExtendVideoInput.title: LTX23QualityExtendVideoInput

seed.description: The seed actually used for generation.
seed.title: Seed

prompt.description: The prompt used for generation (after any expansion).
prompt.title: Prompt

Ltx23QualityExtendVideoOutput.description: Standard output for every endpoint on this app.
Ltx23QualityExtendVideoOutput.title: LTX23QualityOutput

width.description: The width of the generated image.
width.title: Width

height.description: The height of the generated image.
height.title: Height

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
